stories.title: The Passions
stories.fortuneLine: Climb until you meet yourself. The embrace at the top has no body left—only glass, learning both your mouths.
stories.body:
Two lovers climbed the same rose-covered tower from opposite sides.

One carried a flame in a glass lamp. The other carried a bleeding heart.

When they met at the top, they found only a mirror and a shadow embracing.

The flame cracked. The heart stopped.
